title: Build the review lens from every brief in a multi-commit PR
body:
Outcome: `krn brief lens` accepts several briefs (one per implementation commit) and merges their Settled decisions and Hardening residuals, so a multi-commit PR's lens covers every intended change.
Evidence 2026-11-05: PR #234 carried two commits (shard count, compact output) but the lens came from the compact brief only; the prepass raised BLOCKING "default shard change alters full-mode output" (the intended change), and `--prior-record` on the unchanged head exited 64 ("must have a different head SHA"), leaving only an override (.krn/runs/lead/t-q8j6r5c/override.log).
Proof: a lens test with two briefs whose decisions both appear.
